'''Iihot Residence Hall''' was part of an educational university located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Conn Doruggan]], [[Pul]], and [[Tannan]] were students and athletes at the university and resided in the Hall.
